title: Dual network analysis of transcriptome data for discovery of new therapeutic targets in non-small cell lung cancer.
authors: Bai, Yuquan; Zhou, Lu; Zhang, Chuanfen; Guo, Minzhang; Xia, Liang; Tang, Zhenying; Liu, Yi; Deng, Senyi
one_liner_zh: 该文基于转录组差异与网络分析发现NSCLC治疗靶点PSMD2，并做分子对接验证药物亲和力，但核心是肿瘤靶点发现与药效验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究，仅分子对接部分与课题弱相关。
abstract: The drug therapy for non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) have always been issues of poisonous side effect, acquired drug resistance and narrow applicable population. In this study, we built a novel network analysis method (difference- correlation- enrichment- causality- node), which was based on the difference analysis, Spearman correlation network analysis, biological function analysis and Bayesian causality network analysis to discover new therapeutic target of NSCLC in the sequencing data of BEAS-2B and 7 NSCLC cell lines. Our results showed that, as a proteasome subunit coding gene in the central of cell cycle network, PSMD2 was associated with prognosis and was an independent prognostic factor for NSCLC patients. Knockout of PSMD2 inhibited the proliferation of NSCLC cells by inducing cell cycle arrest, and exhibited marked increase of cell cycle blocking protein p21, p27 and decrease of cell cycle driven protein CDK4, CDK6, CCND1 and CCNE1. IPA and molecular docking suggested bortezomib has stronger affinity to PSMD2 compared with reported targets PSMB1 and PSMB5. In vitro and In vivo experiments demonstrated the inhibitory effect of bortezomib in NSCLC with different driven mutations or with tyrosine kinase inhibitors resistance. Taken together, bortezomib could target PSMD2, PSMB1 and PSMB5 to inhibit the proteasome degradation of cell cycle check points, to block cell proliferation of NSCLC, which was potential optional drug for NSCLC patients.
abstract_zh: 非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）的药物治疗一直存在毒副作用、获得性耐药及适用人群狭窄等问题。本研究基于差异分析、Spearman相关网络分析、生物学功能分析及贝叶斯因果网络分析，构建了一种新型网络分析方法（差异-相关-富集-因果-节点），用于在BEAS-2B及7种NSCLC细胞系的测序数据中发现新的治疗靶点。结果表明，作为细胞周期网络核心的蛋白酶体亚基编码基因PSMD2，与NSCLC患者预后相关，并为其独立预后因素。敲除PSMD2通过诱导细胞周期阻滞抑制NSCLC细胞增殖，并显著增加细胞周期阻滞蛋白p21、p27，同时减少细胞周期驱动蛋白CDK4、CDK6、CCND1及CCNE1。IPA及分子对接提示，硼替佐米对PSMD2的亲和力强于已报道的靶点PSMB1和PSMB5。体外及体内实验证实，硼替佐米对不同驱动突变或具有酪氨酸激酶抑制剂耐药性的NSCLC具有抑制作用。综上，硼替佐米可通过靶向PSMD2、PSMB1及PSMB5抑制蛋白酶体对细胞周期检查点的降解，从而阻断NSCLC细胞增殖，可能为NSCLC患者提供潜在的治疗选择。
